title: cyanthillium maritimum
intro: Cyanthillium maritimum, commonly known as Poverty Weed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family that grows in coastal areas and has a history of traditional medicinal use. The health benefits of Cyanthillium maritimum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to treat digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems, making it a valuable remedy for various health concerns. Bioactive constituents of Cyanthillium maritimum include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
